en: Sepia-toned historic view of a large monument in an open square with mountains in the background. The central feature is a tall pedestal topped by a statue of Dante Alighieri, surrounded by smaller sculptural figures at its base. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk around the monument. Trees and a church or bell tower appear to the right, with dramatic rocky mountains behind. Printed text at the top reads the city name and the name of the monument.
